question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $D,$ given by

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -8 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $D$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -8 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(\frac{1}{2}){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -7 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(\frac{2}{7}){R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -7 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $D$ has $5$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $5.$
